title: Metadata-driven hardware parameter editing
summary: Reusable bitfield forms preserve engine-defined field and mode constraints.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2022-03-29. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Built a reusable Angular form control for engine-defined bitfields, mapping hardware metadata and grouped labels to editable numeric values with disabled-state propagation.
Extended bitfield editing to multi-bit segments and wiremode-dependent masks, integrating the control across parameter-editing surfaces.
Used ControlValueAccessor and NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR to integrate domain-specific numeric editing with Angular forms rather than maintaining an unrelated value model.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
